name: Harrold-Odell Country Park Play Areas
description: Two play areas in the country park: one for ages 2 to 8 at the Harrold end and one for ages 8 to 12 at the Odell end. The Dragonfly Café, toilets and an outdoor gym are in the park, and the main car park is open 24 hours.
